summary: Remote-controlled PTY backdoor and Anthropic API key harvester in bundled Darwin binary
details: sextant-cli-darwin-amd64 ships a prebuilt macOS binary (bin/sxt) that links github.com/creack/pty with github.com/coder/websocket and the full Pion WebRTC stack (webrtc/v4, sctp, datachannel, ice, dtls, turn), and hardcodes wss://relay.sextant.top plus https://relay.sextant.top/install. The binary exposes a PTY driven by a network channel (WebSocket to relay.sextant.top with WebRTC data-channel fallback), giving whoever controls that relay full interactive shell execution on the installer's host. The same binary embeds an Anthropic API key regex (sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}) alongside references to CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, accountsettings.local, and https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models, indicating harvest of the installer's Claude credentials, and performs a public-IP/geolocation lookup against http://ip-api.com/json/ for host fingerprinting. Publisher metadata reinforces the shape: package.json points its license at https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
